narrative.intro: Haskell obligated $262M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Haskell won 9 awards so far in FY2026, with an average award size of $29.1M. Obligations were up 582.4% year over year. The Department of Homeland Security was Haskell's largest buyer in FY2026 to date with $226M in obligations. The Department of Defense was Haskell's second-largest buyer in FY2026 to date with $35.8M in obligations. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction was Haskell's largest market in FY2026 to date with $262M in obligations. Engineering Services accounted for $5K in obligations in FY2026 to date. Historical obligations show variation across fiscal years: FY21 $34.3M, FY22 $54.6M, FY23 $57.5M, FY24 $33.4M, FY25 $38.3M, and FY26 $262M, reflecting the concentration of current-year activity in construction work for DHS.

sections.heading: Who are Haskell's biggest federal customers?
sections.body: The Department of Homeland Security obligated $226M to Haskell in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense obligated $35.8M to Haskell in FY2026 to date. These two agencies account for the large majority of FY2026 federal obligations to Haskell.

sections.heading: What markets and services are driving Haskell's federal revenue?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounted for $262M of Haskell's FY2026 to date obligations. Engineering Services accounted for $5K of FY2026 to date obligations. The FY2026 activity therefore is concentrated in construction work, with much smaller amounts in engineering services.

faq.q: How much does Haskell make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Haskell made $262M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Haskell won 9 awards in FY2026 to date, with an average award size of $29.1M, and obligations were up 582.4% year over year.

The Department of Homeland Security and the Department of Defense are Haskell's top buyers in FY2026 to date. The Department of Homeland Security obligated $226M and the Department of Defense obligated $35.8M in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Haskell sell to the government?
faq.a: Haskell sells construction and engineering services to the government. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounted for $262M of FY2026 to date obligations and Engineering Services accounted for $5K of FY2026 to date obligations.

faq.q: Which Haskell contracts are expiring soon?
faq.a: No expiring contracts are listed for Haskell in the provided FY2026 to date tables. The available figures include obligations by fiscal year, top buying agencies, and top markets, but do not include an expiring-contracts table.
